newsitem.title: UK: Federal Express launches Manchester operation.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express launches Manchester operation.

text.p: Federal Express said it is investing an initial $1 million to set up a new FedEx-run Manchester operation, aiming to connect Manchester to world markets within 24-48 hours.

The new operation will provide services such as the "8am next day", delivery service from Manchester to the U.S. and is projected to grow by 35 percent over the next two years. Initially it will create 14 to 15 jobs and this could double within two years, a spokesman said.

The vehicles and couriers will operate from a 15,000 sq. ft. warehouse based near Manchester airport, which handles more than 100,000 tonnes of air cargo annually -- a figure expected to increase to 154,000 tonnes by 2000.

Fedex's UK and Ireland managing director of operations, Paul Murray said that with Manchester's economy growing at 15 percent per year, our objective is to meet demand by being better faster and closer to the customer.
